environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Python 3.9 runtime, x86_64) deployed with custom runtime wrapper via Lambda Layer. The layer installs a Landlock LSM policy (kernel 5.13+ on AL2023-based Lambda runtime) that restricts filesystem write access exclusively to paths matching the regex /tmp/api_cache/[a-f0-9]{32}$. The Landlock ruleset is applied via LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_WRITE_FILE with a single rule hierarchy rooted at /tmp/api_cache, combined with a seccomp-bpf filter loaded by the extension that blocks openat() syscalls where the resolved path contains '../' sequences after canonicalization. The extension binary is compiled as a static PIE and loaded via LD_PRELOAD in the wrapper script before the Python runtime initializes. Additionally, the API Gateway integration uses a VTL mapping template that strips any header matching pattern ^X-Internal-.* before forwarding to Lambda, though this is configured as a 'request template' on the integration, not a Gateway Response.

config.seccomp_filter: blocks openat() with path containing ../ after resolution
config.api_gateway_vtl_template: strips X-Internal-* headers from integration request
